philosophy: One launcher (./pfy). Inference (pluggable OpenAI-compat: Ollama | Shimmy | llama-swap+llama-server) starts first; harnesses attach. Inspired by Ollama then Hermes/OpenCode integrated installers and Exo setup.sh simplicity. PFY_INFERENCE=ollama|shimmy|llama-swap; PFY_INFERENCE_URL / OPENAI_BASE_URL select the worker endpoint. Grok remains default harness/monitor.
inference_env: PFY_INFERENCE=ollama|shimmy|llama-swap; optional PFY_INFERENCE_URL (OpenAI-compat base, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1)

harnesses.name: Ollama
harnesses.summary: Local model server; OpenAI-compat adapter (T-0101). ready only when /api/tags or /v1/models responds
harnesses.setup: install ollama; ollama serve; pull models via pfy models pull
harnesses.issue_stub: Complete Ollama adapter: serve + pull + health in ./pfy start

harnesses.name: Shimmy
harnesses.summary: Lightweight single-binary OpenAI-compat server (X-name candidate). Do not vendor.
harnesses.issue_stub: Shimmy adapter: detect binary, serve in background, /v1/models health; do not vendor

harnesses.name: llama-swap

harnesses.issue_stub: llama-swap adapter: detect binary, pair with llama-server, /v1/models health; do not vendor

harnesses.name: Grok Build / CLI
harnesses.summary: Primary coding agent (subscription); skills via bootstrap/grok-cli. Monitor, not local worker.
